en.text: After six days, Jesus took with him Peter, James, and John his brother, and brought them up into a high mountain by themselves.

zhSimplified.text: 过了六天，耶稣带着彼得、雅各，和雅各的兄弟约翰，暗暗地上了高山，

zhTraditional.text: 過了六天，耶穌帶着彼得、雅各，和雅各的兄弟約翰，暗暗地上了高山，

en.text: He was changed before them. His face shone like the sun, and his garments became as white as the light.

zhSimplified.text: 就在他们面前变了形象，脸面明亮如日头，衣裳洁白如光。

zhTraditional.text: 就在他們面前變了形像，臉面明亮如日頭，衣裳潔白如光。

en.text: Behold, Moses and Elijah appeared to them talking with him.

zhSimplified.text: 忽然，有摩西、以利亚向他们显现，同耶稣说话。

zhTraditional.text: 忽然，有摩西、以利亞向他們顯現，同耶穌說話。

en.text: Peter answered and said to Jesus, “Lord, it is good for us to be here. If you want, let’s make three tents here: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”

zhSimplified.text: 彼得对耶稣说：「主啊，我们在这里真好！你若愿意，我就在这里搭三座棚，一座为你，一座为摩西，一座为以利亚。」

zhTraditional.text: 彼得對耶穌說：「主啊，我們在這裏真好！你若願意，我就在這裏搭三座棚，一座為你，一座為摩西，一座為以利亞。」

en.text: While he was still speaking, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them. Behold, a voice came out of the cloud, saying, “This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased. Listen to him.”

zhSimplified.text: 说话之间，忽然有一朵光明的云彩遮盖他们，且有声音从云彩里出来，说：「这是我的爱子，我所喜悦的。你们要听他！」

zhTraditional.text: 說話之間，忽然有一朵光明的雲彩遮蓋他們，且有聲音從雲彩裏出來，說：「這是我的愛子，我所喜悅的。你們要聽他！」

en.text: When the disciples heard it, they fell on their faces, and were very afraid.

zhSimplified.text: 门徒听见，就俯伏在地，极其害怕。

zhTraditional.text: 門徒聽見，就俯伏在地，極其害怕。

en.text: Jesus came and touched them and said, “Getup, and don’ t be afraid.”

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣进前来，摸他们，说：「起来，不要害怕！」

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌進前來，摸他們，說：「起來，不要害怕！」

en.text: Lifting up their eyes, they saw no one, except Jesus alone.

zhSimplified.text: 他们举目不见一人，只见耶稣在那里。

zhTraditional.text: 他們舉目不見一人，只見耶穌在那裏。

en.text: As they were coming down from the mountain, Jesus commanded them, saying, “Don’ttell anyone what you saw, until the Son of Man has risen from the dead.”

zhSimplified.text: 下山的时候，耶稣吩咐他们说：「人子还没有从死里复活，你们不要将所看见的告诉人。」

zhTraditional.text: 下山的時候，耶穌吩咐他們說：「人子還沒有從死裏復活，你們不要將所看見的告訴人。」

en.text: His disciples asked him, saying, “Then why do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?”

zhSimplified.text: 门徒问耶稣说：「文士为什么说以利亚必须先来？」

zhTraditional.text: 門徒問耶穌說：「文士為甚麼說以利亞必須先來？」

en.text: Jesus answered them, “Elijahindeed comes first, and will restore all things;

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣回答说：「以利亚固然先来，并要复兴万事；

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌回答說：「以利亞固然先來，並要復興萬事；

en.text: butI tell you that Elijah has come already, and they didn’ t recognize him, but did to him whatever they wanted to. Even so the Son of Man will also suffer by them.”

zhSimplified.text: 只是我告诉你们，以利亚已经来了，人却不认识他，竟任意待他。人子也将要这样受他们的害。」

zhTraditional.text: 只是我告訴你們，以利亞已經來了，人卻不認識他，竟任意待他。人子也將要這樣受他們的害。」

en.text: Then the disciples understood that he spoke to them of John the Baptizer.

zhSimplified.text: 门徒这才明白耶稣所说的是指着施洗的约翰。 （可9·14—29；路9·37—43）

zhTraditional.text: 門徒這才明白耶穌所說的是指着施洗的約翰。 （可9‧14－29；路9‧37－43）

en.text: When they came to the multitude, a man came to him, kneeling down to him and saying,

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣和门徒到了众人那里，有一个人来见耶稣，跪下，

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌和門徒到了眾人那裏，有一個人來見耶穌，跪下，

en.text: “Lord, have mercy on my son, for he is epileptic and suffers grievously; for he often falls into the fire, and often into the water.

zhSimplified.text: 说：「主啊，怜悯我的儿子！他害癫痫的病很苦，屡次跌在火里，屡次跌在水里。

zhTraditional.text: 說：「主啊，憐憫我的兒子！他害癲癇的病很苦，屢次跌在火裏，屢次跌在水裏。

en.text: So I brought him to your disciples, and they could not cure him.”

zhSimplified.text: 我带他到你门徒那里，他们却不能医治他。」

zhTraditional.text: 我帶他到你門徒那裏，他們卻不能醫治他。」

en.text: Jesus answered, “Faithless andperverse generation! How long will I be with you? How long will I bear with you? Bring him here to me.”

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣说：「嗳！这又不信又悖谬的世代啊，我在你们这里要到几时呢？我忍耐你们要到几时呢？把他带到我这里来吧！」

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌說：「噯！這又不信又悖謬的世代啊，我在你們這裏要到幾時呢？我忍耐你們要到幾時呢？把他帶到我這裏來吧！」

en.text: Jesus rebuked the demon, and it went out of him, and the boy was cured from that hour.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣斥责那鬼，鬼就出来；从此孩子就痊愈了。

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌斥責那鬼，鬼就出來；從此孩子就痊癒了。

en.text: Then the disciples came to Jesus privately, and said, “Why weren’t we able to cast it out?”

zhSimplified.text: 门徒暗暗地到耶稣跟前，说：「我们为什么不能赶出那鬼呢？」

zhTraditional.text: 門徒暗暗地到耶穌跟前，說：「我們為甚麼不能趕出那鬼呢？」

en.text: He said to them, “Becauseof your unbelief. For most certainly I tell you, if you have faith as a grain of mustard seed, you will tell this mountain, ‘Move from here to there,’ and it will move; and nothing will be impossible for you.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣说：「是因你们的信心小。我实在告诉你们，你们若有信心，像一粒芥菜种，就是对这座山说：『你从这边挪到那边』，它也必挪去；并且你们没有一件不能做的事了。

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌說：「是因你們的信心小。我實在告訴你們，你們若有信心，像一粒芥菜種，就是對這座山說：『你從這邊挪到那邊』，它也必挪去；並且你們沒有一件不能做的事了。

en.text: But this kind doesn’t go out except by prayer and fasting.”

zhSimplified.text: 至于这一类的鬼，若不祷告、禁食，他就不出来。」 （可9·30—32；路9·43—45）

zhTraditional.text: 至於這一類的鬼，若不禱告、禁食，他就不出來 。」 （可9‧30－32；路9‧43－45）

en.text: While they were staying in Galilee, Jesus said to them, “TheSon of Man is about to be delivered up into the hands of men,

zhSimplified.text: 他们还住在加利利的时候，耶稣对门徒说：「人子将要被交在人手里。

zhTraditional.text: 他們還住在加利利的時候，耶穌對門徒說：「人子將要被交在人手裏。

en.text: andthey will kill him, and the third day he will be raised up.” They were exceedingly sorry.

zhSimplified.text: 他们要杀害他，第三日他要复活。」门徒就大大地忧愁。

zhTraditional.text: 他們要殺害他，第三日他要復活。」門徒就大大地憂愁。

en.text: When they had come to Capernaum, those who collected the didrachma coins came to Peter, and said, “Doesn’t your teacher pay the didrachma?”

footnotes.text: 17:24 A didrachma is a Greek silver coin worth 2 drachmas, about as much as 2 Roman denarii, or about 2 days’ wages. It was commonly used to pay the half-shekel temple tax, because 2 drachmas were worth one half shekel of silver. A shekel is about 10 grams or about 0.35 ounces.

zhSimplified.text: 到了迦百农，有收丁税的人来见彼得，说：「你们的先生不纳丁税吗？」

zhTraditional.text: 到了迦百農，有收丁稅的人來見彼得，說：「你們的先生不納丁稅嗎？」

en.text: He said, “Yes.” When he came into the house, Jesus anticipated him, saying, “Whatdo you think, Simon? From whom do the kings of the earth receive toll or tribute? From their children, or from strangers?”

zhSimplified.text: 彼得说：「纳。」他进了屋子，耶稣先向他说：「西门，你的意思如何？世上的君王向谁征收关税、丁税？是向自己的儿子呢？是向外人呢？」

zhTraditional.text: 彼得說：「納。」他進了屋子，耶穌先向他說：「西門，你的意思如何？世上的君王向誰征收關稅、丁稅？是向自己的兒子呢？是向外人呢？」

en.text: Peter said to him, “From strangers.” Jesus said to him, “Thereforethe children are exempt.

zhSimplified.text: 彼得说：「是向外人。」耶稣说：「既然如此，儿子就可以免税了。

zhTraditional.text: 彼得說：「是向外人。」耶穌說：「既然如此，兒子就可以免稅了。

en.text: But, lest we cause them to stumble, go to the sea, cast a hook, and take up the first fish that comes up. When you have opened its mouth, you will find a stater coin. Takethat, and give it to them for me and you.”

footnotes.text: 17:27 A stater is a silver coin equivalent to four Attic or two Alexandrian drachmas, or a Jewish shekel: just exactly enough to cover the half-shekel temple tax for two people. A shekel is about 10 grams or about 0.35 ounces, usually in the form of a silver coin.

zhSimplified.text: 但恐怕触犯他们，你且往海边去钓鱼，把先钓上来的鱼拿起来，开了它的口，必得一块钱，可以拿去给他们，作你我的税银。」

zhTraditional.text: 但恐怕觸犯他們，你且往海邊去釣魚，把先釣上來的魚拿起來，開了牠的口，必得一塊錢，可以拿去給他們，作你我的稅銀。」
